name: Load Agent Skill
description: Load a skill by name, from the [Skills] index or from what an earlier load revealed, or by exact advertised ref. A ref outside the current advertised surface requires an explicit skill/load capability. By default its instructions are appended once and stay in context; volatile:true instead watches the source and appends only when its rendered value changes. Its tools are added with the same append-only event. The loaded skill header names the exact unload key if you later need to remove one; routine cleanup is unnecessary. Loading never grants invocation authority. The result is structural: revealed names the skills this load newly made loadable and skillIndex describes them, one line each; existing means identical content was already loaded under that path.

name.description: A skill name from the [Skills] index or from an earlier load's revealed skills

ref.description: Exact skill address; must already be advertised or be covered by an explicit skill/load capability

budget.description: Accounting budget for the skill's context entry (default 2000, max 10000)

volatile.description: Watch the skill source before each model call and append new instructions only when its rendered value changes. Default false.
